name: Batken Glacial Lake
context: An unnamed glacier-detached lake in the Kyrgyz glacial-lake inventory (2024 record 1115). Its open-water area fell over ten days in September 2024. Partial drainage is a possible explanation that needs independent evidence.

name: Petrov Lake
context: A moraine-dammed lake at the terminus of Petrov Glacier. Satellite research documents its evolution from 1973 to 2023.

name: Lower Lake Merzbacher
context: The South Inylchek Glacier dams the lower basin. Its seasonal filling and drainage, together with floating ice, complicate open-water comparisons.

name: Western Zyndan Lake
context: Field and satellite research documents an outburst in July 2008. GLOFCA documents another outburst in August 2024.

name: Uchitel Lake
context: A seasonal proglacial lake below Uchitel Glacier. Field research documents partial drainage in 2015.

name: Lake Ala-Kol
context: A glacier-fed high-altitude lake. Sediment cores record past fluctuations of the upstream glacier and local climate.

name: Adygine Lake 2
context: The largest lake in the Adygine cascade lost direct contact with the retreating glacier in the 1990s. Field monitoring documents the role of its surface outlet.

name: Adygine Lake 3
context: The upper proglacial lake of the Adygine cascade formed after glacier retreat in 2005. Field observations track its development and connection with the downstream lakes.
